howItWorks.title: How YojanaSetu Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple, transparent steps to discover government benefits without paperwork hurdles.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell us about your household, state, occupation, or category in plain language. No identity documents required.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our rule engine checks eligibility criteria and identifies schemes where you are eligible or may qualify.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get verified links to official government portals (.gov.in / .nic.in) along with exact checklists of required documents.

trust.title: Built on Trust, Privacy, and Verified Sources
trust.subtitle: Why citizens and advisors rely on YojanaSetu for scheme discovery.
trust.card1Desc: Every scheme rule and criterion is checked directly against published central and state government gazettes and portals.
trust.card2Desc: We do not save your details on our servers or in your browser storage. They are held only in this page's memory and are cleared when you refresh or close the tab. We never ask for or store Aadhaar numbers, phone numbers, or bank accounts.
trust.card3Desc: We clearly distinguish between Eligible, Maybe Eligible, and Not Eligible with plain-language explanations for each criterion.

consent.title: Before You Check Your Eligibility
consent.intro: Please review how your information is handled before continuing. YojanaSetu is designed from the ground up to preserve your confidentiality.
consent.point1Desc: Basic criteria such as your age, state, occupation, and household income bracket to evaluate eligibility.
consent.point2Desc: We do not save your details on our servers or in your browser storage. They are held only in this page's memory and are cleared when you refresh or close the tab.
consent.point3Desc: What you type is sent to our server and to an AI service so it can understand your situation. We do not save it, and the AI service has its own privacy policy. The AI never decides eligibility. Fixed rules do.
consent.point4Title: Never enter identity or banking details
consent.point4Desc: Never type your Aadhaar number, PAN card, phone number, email address, physical address, or bank account numbers.
consent.point5Desc: Social category and disability status are completely optional and always offer "Prefer not to say".
consent.footerNote: By continuing, you agree to temporary in-memory processing of your situation.

about.title: About YojanaSetu and Legal Disclaimer
about.subtitle: Empowering citizens across India to access entitlements through transparent technology.
about.missionText: Millions of eligible citizens miss out on government welfare benefits due to fragmented information, complicated eligibility criteria, and lack of clear guidance. YojanaSetu ('Scheme Bridge') was built as an independent, transparent bridge connecting citizens directly to official schemes.
about.independenceText: YojanaSetu is an independent project and is NOT affiliated with, sponsored by, or an official website of the Government of India or any state government. Official applications must always be completed on respective government portals ending in .gov.in or .nic.in.
about.accuracyText: All scheme criteria and summaries on YojanaSetu are cross-referenced against published government gazettes, guidelines, and portal documentation. However, government policies and budget allotments change periodically. Always verify with official authorities before applying.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is our foundational principle. We do not track, collect, or store personal identifiers.
privacy.noPiiText: We never ask for, collect, or store Aadhaar numbers, PAN cards, voter IDs, phone numbers, email addresses, names, or bank account details. We do not save your details on our servers or in your browser storage. They are held only in this page's memory and are cleared when you refresh or close the tab.
privacy.storageText: We only save your accessibility and interface preferences (selected language, text size preference, and high contrast toggle) in your browser's local storage. Your user queries and eligibility profiles are never saved to local storage or transmitted to analytics services.
privacy.cookiesText: YojanaSetu uses no commercial tracking cookies, no third-party behavioral pixels, and no fingerprinting technologies.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Conditions of use for the YojanaSetu citizen portal.
terms.infoText: YojanaSetu is an informational directory and eligibility guidance tool. It does not disburse funds, grant approvals, or accept government applications. Submission of welfare applications must be done through sanctioned government offices or websites.
terms.liabilityText: While we strive for absolute accuracy based on official government documentation, YojanaSetu and its contributors are not liable for any discrepancies, policy changes, rejected applications, or outcomes resulting from use of this information.
terms.redirectText: Links leading to external government websites (.gov.in, .nic.in) are provided for convenience. We do not control or endorse external third-party software.
